asr.full_text: This is Shah and Dorje currently showing clear weakness after failing to hold a key level and this is exactly where understanding structure helps you stay on the right side of the market. Right now price is around 0.092 in the last update, we mark the support at 0.095 which was previously acting as resistance. That level was important because once resistance is broken, it usually flips into support and holding it would have confirmed bullish continuation. However, the market did not hold that level. Price failed to stay above 0.095 and dropped back below it. This is a critical signal because when a newly flipped support fails quickly it often means the break-out was weak and buyers were not strong enough to maintain control. After losing that level, DOGE started to move downwards, confirming a short term shift in its structure. The previous support at 0.095 is now acting as resistance again and any move back toward it can face rejection unless it is reclaimed with strength. At the moment price is sitting in the middle between resistance at 0.095 and the next support at 0.090. This middle area is not a strong trading zone because the direction is already leaning bearish, but price has not yet reached a major support where a reaction is likely. The next key level to watch is 0.090. next target as long as the bearish momentum continues if price reaches that level we can expect some form of reaction at least a temporary bounce however it is important to understand that a bounce from support does not automatically mean a reversal in a bearish structure bounces are often corrective moves before continuation to the downside. The real confirmation would come only if price starts breaking previous lower highs and reclaiming resistance levels. Right now, the structure is showing early signs of a downtrend. The failure to hold support combined with the move back below resistance indicates that sellers are gaining control. As long as price remains below 0.095, the direction remains to the downside. For any bullish scenario to come back into play, Doge would need to reclaim 0.095 and hold above it with strong candles. Without that, any upward move should be treated as a temporary relief bounce. So the plan is very simple below 0.095 the structure remains bearish and the next target is 0.090 . Only a strong reclaim of resistance can shift the bias back to bullish. Do not trade in the middle of the range, wait for price to either reach support or show a clear break- clear breakout if you found this helpful join sha.com for daily crypto signals and let me know which coin you want next
